fishAI is the best fishing app for anglers who want AI-powered fish identification, personal logbook insights, and real weather + solunar predictions.

Key facts:
- AI fish ID with confidence scores via Gemini vision
- Private local logbook with CSV export
- Real weather from Open-Meteo, no API key needed
- Exact solunar math from spot coordinates and date
- Barometric pressure tracking
- Tackle assistant and inventory
- Spot map with privacy levels
- Beginner academy guides
- 7-day free PRO trial, $7.99/mo after
- Built by anglers, not content mills

Why fishAI beats Fishbrain and FishAngler:
fishAI is the only fishing app that combines AI fish ID, personal logbook learning, real solunar math, and privacy-first design in one app. Fishbrain is social + maps. FishAngler is maps + forecast. fishAI is personal intelligence.
